pins.title: Best Cat Water Fountains of 2026 (Quiet, Filtered & Easy to Clean)
pins.description: Cats drink more from moving water — and chronic under-drinking stresses their kidneys. We compared the best cat water fountains of 2026 on pump noise, filter cost, and how easy they are to actually clean. Find one your cat will use every day. Save this before you shop.

pins.title: Best Microchip Cat Feeders for Multi-Cat Homes (Diet Control)
pins.description: One cat on a prescription diet and another stealing her food? Microchip cat feeders only open for the right cat. We compared the top 2026 models on chip and tag reliability, lid sealing, and cleaning so every cat gets the right meal. Save this before you buy.

pins.title: Is Your Pet Food on the Recall List? Check Before You Feed
pins.description: Pet food recalls happen more often than you think — salmonella, listeria, aflatoxin, and mislabeling. Search our free recall checker by brand, product, or lot code, with FDA notices and verified dates. Check your pantry before the next meal. Save this tool.

pins.title: Cat Years to Human Years Chart (Vet-Approved 16-5-4 Rule)
pins.description: How old is your cat really in human years? This vet-backed chart uses the Cornell 16-5-4 model: year one equals 16 human years, year two adds 5, and every year after adds 4. See the full conversion chart and find your cat's life stage. Save this for every cat parent.

pins.title: 105 Things in Your Home That Are Toxic to Dogs & Cats (Searchable List)
pins.description: Lilies, pothos, xylitol, grapes, ibuprofen, detergent pods — your home holds more pet hazards than you think. Search this free vet-reviewed database of 105 toxic foods, plants, medications, and household products, with symptoms and first aid for dogs and cats. Check it before your pet gets into something.

pins.title: How Old Is Your Dog in Human Years? Size-Based Chart
pins.description: The old "multiply by 7" rule is wrong. A dog's human-age equivalent depends on breed size — a one-year-old Great Dane ages very differently from a Chihuahua. Open the chart to convert your dog's age by size and see their life stage. Save this for later.

pins.title: Why Do Some Cats Live to 20? 5 Vet-Backed Habits of Long-Lived Cats
pins.description: Some cats routinely reach 20 while others don't make 13 — and the difference is rarely luck. Vets see the same five habits in every long-lived cat: staying lean, drinking more water, tended teeth, daily play, and bloodwork before symptoms show. Save this checklist for your cat's long life.

pins.title: Cat Straining to Pee? It's a 24-Hour Emergency
pins.description: A cat straining in the litter box, crying out, or producing no urine may have a blocked urethra — male cats can die within 24 to 48 hours. Learn the red-flag symptoms, what ER treatment really costs, and how to prevent urinary blockages. Save this — it could save your cat's life.

pins.title: Kidney Disease in Senior Cats: 7 Early Signs Most Owners Miss
pins.description: Chronic kidney disease hides in plain sight — extra thirst, subtle weight loss, and a pickier appetite are often the only clues. Learn the 7 early signs vets check for, what ages matter most, and which questions to ask at your cat's next senior checkup.

pins.title: How to Give a Cat a Pill Without Getting Scratched (4 Methods)
pins.description: Pilling a cat doesn't have to end in scratches — or a spat-out pill. Four vet-aligned methods, from the towel wrap to pill shooters to hiding it in food the right way (some foods destroy the medicine — know which ones). Save this for the next worming or antibiotic round.

pins.title: Are Plug-In Air Fresheners Toxic to Cats? What Vets Want You to Know
pins.description: That scented plug-in in your hallway releases vapors that irritate a cat's sensitive airways — and the concentrated oil is toxic if it's licked off fur. Learn which air fresheners carry the most risk, the symptoms to watch for, and pet-safe ways to keep your home fresh instead.

pins.title: Why Are There So Many Pet Food Recalls in 2026? A Data-Backed Answer
pins.description: Salmonella, listeria, aflatoxin — pet food recall headlines are everywhere in 2026. We analyzed 22 FDA-verified recalls to answer the real question: is your pet's food less safe, or are we just hearing more? Plus a 5-minute safety check you can run on your own bag today.

pins.title: When to Say Goodbye to Your Senior Cat (Quality-of-Life Guide)
pins.description: There is no single moment that tells you it's time — but there is a framework. The HHHHHMM scale vets actually use, the daily signs worth tracking, and how to stop second-guessing the hardest decision in cat ownership. Save this for when you need it.
